time_origin: Elapsed proper time from the initial a=1 state. isPresent=true identifies t=0; its chart coordinate logYears=0 is a plotting sentinel, not log10(0). Other rows use logYears=log10(elapsed years).
logYears: log10(elapsed yr); plotting sentinel 0 at t=0 when isPresent=true
logA: log10(scale factor). Null if this logarithm itself exceeds numeric range.
expansionIndex: sign(log10a) * log10(1+abs(log10a)). Retained at enormous expansion.
logH: log10(abs(H)/(km s^-1 Mpc^-1)); contraction sign is encoded by regime=contraction
logRhoB: log10(rho_b/rho_critical_today); null for absent or unrepresentable density
logRhoDM: log10(rho_dm/rho_critical_today); null for absent or unrepresentable density
logRhoR: log10(total radiation/rho_critical_today); null also when nonthermal daughter production is not continued in a tail
logRhoDE: log10(abs(rho_de)/rho_critical_today); sign from active configuration/events; null for absent or unrepresentable density, and after a CPL dark energy is dropped at the de-extinct event (w >= 1/3 and abs(Omega_de)(1+3w) below the extinction threshold, 1e-20 by default)
omegaM,omegaR,omegaDE,omegaK: Instantaneous Friedmann fractions; undefined at H=0; asymptotic fractions are leading-order limiting values
logTcmb: log10(adiabatic photon temperature/K); null if the log is out of range
logRadiationEffectiveT: log10(effective total radiation temperature/K), normalized to initial radiation density; not an asserted thermal spectrum, null if unsupported
logHubbleRadiusMpc: log10(c/abs(H)/Mpc); undefined at H=0; not generally an event horizon
logComovingHubbleMpc: log10(c/(a abs(H))/Mpc); null if undefined or unrepresentable
logHorizonEntropy: log10(S/k_B) of the de Sitter horizon, S = pi c^3 R^2/(hbar g G) with R = c/H and G multiplier g, only where positive dark energy with w = -1 to rounding dominates to 1e-8 (n = 0 in a matched tail); null elsewhere; not a total entropy
logHorizonTemperature: log10(T_GH/K), Gibbons-Hawking temperature hbar H/(2 pi k_B) of the de Sitter horizon, under the same criterion as logHorizonEntropy; null elsewhere; absent in files written before it existed. Not added to the CMB or radiation density
stellarFraction: Illustrative comoving stellar-population logistic proxy, not a star count
baryonSurvival,electronSurvival: Exponential comoving tracer survival. Decay products do not feed back into background dynamics; numeric zero can mean underflow
bhMassFractions: Representative remaining black-hole masses normalized by their initial masses, isolated blackbody approximation
constraintResidual: Independent Friedmann residual on time-domain branches; zero in expansion branches where H is defined algebraically by the constraint, not an independent conservation test
regime: numerical, asymptotic, or contraction; asymptotic also marks the closed-form CPL continuation to a Big Rip; consult result.diagnostics for the solved domain and termination reason
derived.nariaiMass: Nariai mass c^3/(3 sqrt(3) G H_Lambda) in solar masses, the largest Schwarzschild-de Sitter black hole, for a positive cosmological constant (lambda or constant w = -1) with H_Lambda = H0 sqrt(OmegaDE); null otherwise. Result.derived is absent in invalid results and older files
derived.blackHoleMassLimit: Largest black-hole mass accepted by validation, in solar masses: the smaller of the Nariai mass and c^3/(2 G H0), whose Schwarzschild radius equals today's Hubble radius
derived.cplContinuation: CPL laws with wa != 0 only (absent otherwise and in older files): the proof-based continuation applied, or null when neither theorem held within the run or a custom event changes w or the vacuum; always null for closed models with wa < 0 (extinction applies to flat or open models only), whose recollapse is integrated in proper time or which stop at the extinction. theorem is extinction (wa < 0: w >= 1/3 and abs(Omega_de)(1+3w) < threshold, dark energy dropped) or big-rip (wa > 0: w <= -1 and the non-dark-energy fractions sum to <= 1e-8); logYears, logA, w and omegaDE describe the accepted state where it was verified; ripLogYears is log10 elapsed years of the finite-time singularity from quadrature of the closed-form density (null for extinction). A literal extrapolation of an observational fit ansatz, not a prediction
events: Equality and CMB/Hawking (cool-M, warm-M) and de Sitter horizon-temperature crossings are located on the continuous solution and have an output sample at their time; crossings within the first elapsed year are shown at logYears 0. de-extinct marks a dropped CPL dark energy and rip a finite-time Big Rip (constant-phantom tail or closed-form CPL continuation); samples stop before a rip
